hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/backend/.venv/bin/ruff"; case "$f" in *backend/*.py) [ -x "$r" ] && "$r" format "$f" && "$r" check --fix --unfixable F401 "$f";; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; case "$f" in *frontend/*.ts|*frontend/*.tsx|*frontend/*.js|*frontend/*.jsx|*frontend/*.css|*frontend/*.json) [ -x "$p" ] && (cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/frontend" && "$p" --write --ignore-unknown "$f");; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
